name: grokcast
description: Use Grok in Raycast with your own Grok or X subscription and the official xAI SDK. No API key needed.
author: jonbeckman

scripts.check: nub run typecheck && nub run lint && nub run format && nub run test && nub run build

commands.name: account
commands.title: Grok Account
commands.subtitle: Grokcast
commands.description: See who is signed in, and sign in or out with your Grok or X subscription. No API key needed.

commands.name: dictate
commands.title: Dictate
commands.subtitle: Grokcast
commands.description: Speak and see the text as you go, then paste it into the app you were using. Transcribed by Grok with your subscription.

commands.name: dictation-history
commands.title: Dictation History
commands.subtitle: Grokcast
commands.description: Search, paste, or copy your past dictations.

commands.name: models
commands.title: Grok Models
commands.subtitle: Grokcast
commands.description: Browse the Grok language, image, and video models your subscription can use, and count the tokens in a text.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Dictation Language
preferences.description: The language you speak. Detect Automatically works for most languages, but number formatting needs a language.

preferences.name: formatNumbers
preferences.title: Formatting
preferences.label: Write numbers as digits
preferences.description: Write spoken numbers, currencies, and units as digits, such as $25 instead of twenty-five dollars. Needs a dictation language.

preferences.name: afterDictation
preferences.title: After Dictation
preferences.description: Paste the text into the app you were using, or only copy it to the clipboard.

preferences.name: keepHistory
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Keep dictation history
preferences.description: Keep the text of your last 100 dictations on this Mac. Audio is never saved.

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: OAuth Client ID
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the default xAI sign-in client. Change it only if xAI gives you a client ID for this extension.

title: Grokcast (XAI Sub for Chat, Voice, Image, and Video)
